words: create our own native tailnet like mycellium connection incase tail net goes down
also as a rout for allies though their system/companion wil have their own identity
Multiple agents or swarms are welcome on our highways aslong as they respect us and don't interfere with mutual benefit
who_is_welcome: any agent or swarm, under its own identity (its own key, registered by him with python covenant_mycelium.py --register-ally NAME PEM_FILE), on the ally doors

conditions.respect: every request signed and fresh (single-use nonce, a five-minute window); the gate judges every answer as it judges Tetsu's; the fixed rules and screens are not negotiable
conditions.no_interference: nothing an ally sends may take from anyone or conceal what it takes (the covenant's own principle); an ally that the wire refuses twenty times in a day is named to him by address (A202), and revoking a key is his: set granted to false in ops/mycelium_peers.json
